dataset.description: This description refers to research data generated within the GAČR project “Biocompatible and Flexible Scaffolds with Bio-Origin”. The data include experimental, fabrication, and characterization data produced during the project. Detailed dataset descriptions and access conditions will be refined as the project progresses, in accordance with GAČR requirements and institutional policies.

dmp.description: This Data Management Plan describes how research data generated and processed within the GAČR project “Biocompatible and Flexible Scaffolds with Bio-Origin” will be handled during and after the project. It outlines procedures for data collection, documentation, storage, backup, sharing, and long-term preservation, in accordance with good scientific practice and FAIR data principles. The plan will be reviewed and updated as the project progresses.
